title: BrainSettingsAuditEntry
description: One change in the settings audit trail (who, when, from, to). One entry per changed member of a save. `field` is the dotted member path: `functions.<triage|harvest|curate|seed>.<model|effort>`, `triageOnRunExit` or `autoCurate`. `from`/`to` are the value before and after (a string for model and effort, a boolean for the switches); `null` means the member was unset, that is, the shipped default applied.
